html:
The Nangatara, shown on the map as Yulparitja, are an Aboriginal people of the Great Sandy Desert in Western Australia, inland from the northwest coast.

They spoke a form of the Western Desert language. Neighbours on the map include the Mangala to the north, the Nyangumarta to the west and the Martu peoples to the south. Desert life depended on knowing the waterholes and moving between them after rain. In the 1900s many people walked in from the desert to stations, missions and towns. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Nangatara, shown on the map as Yulparitja, are an Aboriginal people of the Great Sandy Desert in Western Australia, inland from the northwest coast.
